findings.title: Second definition of `self.downsize` overwrites the 4-argument overload
findings.body: Ruby does not support method overloading by arity. Defining `def self.downsize(from, to, dimensions, opts={})` on line 149 overwrites `def self.downsize(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts={})` on line 145. Any caller using the `(from, to, max_width, max_height, opts)` signature will either raise `ArgumentError: wrong number of arguments (5 for 3..4)` when `opts` is provided, or pass `max_height` as `opts` (an Integer) when called with 4 arguments, raising `TypeError: no implicit conversion of Symbol into Integer` when `opts[:allow_animation]` is evaluated in `self.optimize`.

findings.title: Hardcoded 10MB client limit ignores `max_attachment_size_kb` and larger site settings
findings.body: Replacing `Discourse.SiteSettings['max_' + type + '_size_kb']` with a hardcoded `10 * 1024` applies the 10MB limit to all upload types, including non-image attachments (`type === 'attachment'`). Because the server only downsizes images, attachments larger than `max_attachment_size_kb` are no longer caught by client-side validation before upload. Additionally, if an administrator configures `max_image_size_kb` or `max_attachment_size_kb` above 10MB, the client will reject valid uploads (and report the hardcoded 10MB limit on HTTP 413 at line 246).

findings.title: Downsizing with `"80%"` fails for animated GIFs and retries 5 times on any failure
findings.body: `OptimizedImage.downsize` is called with dimensions `"80%"` and `allow_animation: SiteSetting.allow_animated_thumbnails`. For GIF files when `allow_animation` is true, `OptimizedImage.optimize` dispatches to `downsize_instructions_animated`, which delegates to `resize_instructions_animated` and runs `gifsicle ... --resize-fit 80%`. `gifsicle`'s `--resize-fit` option requires `WxH` pixel dimensions rather than a percentage (percentage scaling in `gifsicle` uses `--scale`), so the command always fails. Furthermore, because the `while` loop does not check the boolean return value of `OptimizedImage.downsize` (which also fails on formats like SVG), it will repeat the failing command all 5 times.

findings.title: `tempfile` descriptor and `tempfile.size` become stale after `ImageOptim` replaces `tempfile.path`
findings.body: `OptimizedImage.downsize` runs `ImageOptim.new.optimize_image!(to)` on `tempfile.path`. `ImageOptim#optimize_image!` writes the optimized image to a new file and atomically replaces the destination path via `File.rename`, meaning `tempfile.path` points to a new inode while the open `tempfile` object still holds a file descriptor to the old, unlinked inode. Because `Tempfile#size` queries `fstat` on the open descriptor rather than `File.size(tempfile.path)`, `tempfile.size` in the `while` loop and in `Upload.create_for` (as well as reads from `tempfile` itself) will not reflect the replaced file unless `tempfile` is reopened.
